title: AetherGate Resource Pack
description: AetherGate is an immersive teleportation plugin designed for Minecraft Paper servers. This is the resource pack required by the plugin.
body:
# AetherGate Resource Pack
This is the resource pack corresponding to the plugin AetherGate. Please download the corresponding version of the resource pack when using the corresponding version of the plugin.
## plugin
To download the plugin, please visit [AetherGate](https://modrinth.com/plugin/aethergate).
